notes: fw v0.1.2 — the zero-typing provisioning firmware: WiFi-only first-boot form, POST /provision, + all audit repairs + the TFT block protocol.

bug_fixes: The full-audit fixes: the display-restart no longer kills the touch task, the MQTT client no longer leaks on WiFi reconnects, the clock/relay writes can no longer corrupt a display update mid-transfer, a resend no longer corrupts the recorded checksum, the dashboard command channel is injection-proof, the provisioning page is CSRF-guarded, quick taps are no longer lost to split UART reads, the log buffer is task-safe, a 33-page dashboard is supported, and a backslash password no longer becomes empty
features: PAGE SWIPE: drag left/right on any dashboard page to move between your pages (a swipe over a tile never toggles it)
